app.name: Smart Farming Assistant
ai.title: AI Assistant
ai.chat.description: Ask about the farm in plain language. Every answer is composed from the live readings for the selected field — the assistant cannot state a number the sensors did not produce.
ai.insights.description: What your latest readings mean, explained one field at a time — what was seen, what it means and what to do.
ai.input.placeholder: Ask SIYA anything about your farm…
ai.error: Something went wrong while contacting the AI. Please try again.
ai.q.yellowLeaves: Why are my leaves turning yellow?
ai.q.irrigate: When should I irrigate my crop?
ai.q.disease: How can I identify crop disease?
ai.q.soilHealth: How do I improve soil health?
ai.emptyBody: Tap a question below or type your own. SIYA answers farming questions in your language.
ai.keyHint: Enter to send · Shift + Enter for a new line
ai.input.label: Your question about the farm
ai.disclaimer.live: SIYA is an AI model. It only uses the readings shown for your field and will tell you when data is missing. For serious crop losses, check with a local agriculture officer.
ai.disclaimer.fallback: The AI service is not connected, so SIYA is using simple built-in rules and can only answer a few kinds of questions. Connect the AI service for full answers.
page.weather.title: Weather & Climate
page.weather.description: Conditions measured in your field right now, plus the days ahead — and what each of them means for your crop.
page.cropHealth.title: Crop Health
page.cropHealth.description: A simple score for how your crop is doing, and the readings behind it. Pick a field to see what is helping or hurting it.
page.soilIrrigation.title: Soil & Irrigation
page.soilIrrigation.description: How much water is in the soil right now, whether that is enough for this crop, and when to water next.
page.sensors.title: Sensors
page.sensors.description: Live readings from every sensor node in your fields, and whether each one is reporting normally.
page.analytics.title: Yield & Resources
page.analytics.description: How your field has behaved over time, how much water you have used, and an early estimate of what it may yield.
page.reports.title: Reports
page.reports.description: Records of your season you can keep or share — the same readings and alerts you see on the live screens.
page.riskForecast.title: Risk Forecast
page.riskForecast.description: What could go wrong in your field over the next seven days, how likely it is, and what lowers each risk.
page.diseaseDetection.title: Disease & Pest Detection
page.diseaseDetection.description: Photograph an affected leaf and submit it for analysis. The result names the suspected condition, how confident the service is, and what to do next.
settings.languageHelp: Choose the language for the app and for SIYA the AI Assistant. You can change this at any time.
err.title: We couldn't load this data
err.offline: The Smart Farming Assistant service is not responding. It may still be starting up — wait a moment and try again.
err.generic: Nothing was lost. Try loading it again, and if it keeps failing, check that the service is running.
sevMeaning.critical: The crop is being harmed right now.
sevMeaning.high: Damage is likely if this is left another day.
sevMeaning.medium: Worth handling soon, but not urgent.
sevMeaning.info: Nothing to do — shared so you know the field state.
phrase.soil_moisture.low: Drier than this crop prefers — roots are working harder for water.
phrase.soil_moisture.high: Wetter than field capacity — roots may be short of air.
phrase.soil_moisture.ok: Good moisture for this crop and growth stage.
phrase.air_temperature.low: Cooler than ideal — growth slows at these temperatures.
phrase.air_temperature.high: Hot enough to stress the crop during the day.
phrase.soil_temperature.low: Cool root zone — nutrient uptake slows down.
phrase.soil_temperature.high: Warm root zone — the crop will use water faster.
phrase.soil_temperature.ok: Root zone sits in a healthy range.
phrase.humidity.low: Dry air pulls moisture out of the leaves quickly.
phrase.humidity.high: Humid air keeps leaves wet and favours fungal disease.
phrase.humidity.ok: Humidity is in a healthy range for the canopy.
phrase.light.low: Less sunlight than the crop needs to build biomass.
phrase.light.high: Very strong sunlight — pair it with enough soil water.
phrase.vpd.low: The air is asking little water of the crop right now.
phrase.vpd.high: The air is pulling water faster than roots can replace it.
phrase.vpd.ok: Moderate water demand from the air.
phrase.fallback.low: Below the preferred range for this crop.
phrase.fallback.high: Above the preferred range for this crop.
phrase.fallback.ok: Inside the preferred range for this crop.
phrase.night: Night — no sunlight expected at this hour.
phrase.notReporting: This channel is not reporting reliably — check the node.
dash.error: We couldn't load your farm overview

dash.clear.title: Nothing needs your attention today.
